_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (was #6 in the v1 system); csv_id is authoritative.
sub_palette: akkadian backbone + egyptian overlay (intra-family blend, Mesopotamian-leaning)

blend.lean: Mesopotamian-heavy - an Akkadian river-valley law-civ that absorbed a southern solar-funerary (Egyptian) people: the Two-Rivers register of rule, kin, temple and land dominates, with the Nile/desert/tomb-cult vocabulary folded in beneath one Akkadian phonology.

_note: Intra-Near-Eastern blend (Mesopotamian + Egyptian): a river-valley law-giving civ with a solar-funerary overlay. Backbone = Akkadian (phonology, morphology, administrative titles); overlay = Egyptian (Per-/Pa- toponyms, -et/-aa touches, sun-disc and tomb-cult flavor). civ = feudal. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Akkadian/Egyptian registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are SECOND-ORDER phoneme-morphs: the Agrippan canon as already morphed into Punic (Barcan) trade-forms, then drifted again through Akkadian phonology - giving the Near-Eastern family a shared Punic-cognate ancestor. [REWORKED 2026-06-27 to base/hybrid model: csv_id HYB_21; all-three alignment; English display titles + Akkadian ruler_native; deep-fusion lexicon + fusion_rules.]

phonology.palette: Akkadian backbone (sh, ', kh, ts, q; vowels a i u; endings -u/-tu/-um; mimation) with Egyptian overlay touches (occasional -aa/-et, Per-/Pa- in toponyms); theophoric stems are second-order morphs of the Punic forms (Tulrishu-, Arganzu-, Urlanzu-, Rialtu-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; mimation -um; construct chains; gutturals frequent; stress penultimate.

sound_changes: Egyptian dj/tj collapse into Akkadian emphatics/sibilants: dj>z or t, tj>s or t (the southern stops fold into the Two-Rivers inventory)
Egyptian kh is retained (shared with Akkadian kh); Egyptian h/' kept; Egyptian r-for-l preserved
Egyptian endings take Akkadian case-vowels and mimation: long -aa>-u, feminine -et/-it>-tu, bare consonant-final roots gain -u/-um
Akkadian penultimate stress imposed on every root from either parent; construct chains (Bit-/Per-/Kar-/Pa-) carry the compounds
vowels normalize to the Akkadian a/i/u triad (Egyptian reconstructed e/o>i/u); CVC syllable shape preferred
fusion_rules.source_tilt: Nile/desert/funerary words and several material/staple terms draw on Egyptian roots (the absorbed southern people keep their river, sand, tomb and trade-good words); rule, kin, temple and the broader land/terrain vocabulary draw on Akkadian roots (the dominant Two-Rivers register); every chosen root is then run through the Akkadian sound-filter so the split is inaudible.
portmanteaus: desert deshret+sheru>deshru (the red waste, Egy desher + Akk seru)
oasis wehat+namu>wehatu (the green in the waste)

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Egyptian Nile/desert/funerary/material roots + Akkadian rule/kin/temple/land roots, all run through one Akkadian-shaped sound-law (Egyptian dj/tj folded to emphatics, -aa/-et to -u/-tu, penultimate stress, construct chains); portmanteaus mark the blended river/solar/funerary institutions. One word per concept - no slash pairs.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic 'mar' (son of), with Egyptian 'sa' as a secondary filiation; theophoric given names on the morphed god-stems; family/profession house.
morphology.compounding_rule: construct chains: Bit-/Per-[god] (house/temple of), Kar-[god] (port of), Pa-[noun] (the-, Egy); resource + feature.

title_ladder.government: feudal (Mesopotamian backbone; the law-code/temple bureaucracy and a southern solar-kingship overlay are narrative flavor)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Akkadian backbone, ascending; the imperial tier blends in the Egyptian overlay: Shar-Per (king of the Great House) over the Per-Sharrutu. -u/-utu rhyme the lower native tiers (Hazannu/Hazannutu ... Sharru/Sharrutu). Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march; Shaknu (governor) county; Turtanu (commander) duchy; Rubu (prince) principality. DISPLAY titles are English, except the kingdom tier shows the approved foreign throne-term Pharaoh (the Egyptian-overlay kingship; the native form remains Sharru, the v1 empire tier was Shar-Per). (Rank titles are the real Akkadian/Egyptian register, allowed.)
title_ladder.heir: Mar-Sharri (son of the king / crown prince)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: given (often theophoric) + patronymic (mar-X), or an Egyptian-style filiation (sa-X) and earned epithet for the southern nobility.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the river-valley officials use a profession/house title; the southern (solar-cult) nobility use filiation + epithet.
people_name_convention.theophoric: given names from the morphed deity-names + an Akkadian verb or Egyptian element: X-iddina (X-gave), Warad-X (servant-of-X), or X-hotep (X-is-content, Egy overlay). e.g. Tulrishu-iddina, Warad-Arganzu, Arganzu-hotep.

religion._note: Deity-names are second-order phoneme-morphs: the canonical Agrippan pantheon as morphed into Punic (Barcan) trade-forms, then drifted again through Akkadian phonology with an Egyptian solar-funerary coloring - never real Mesopotamian or Egyptian gods. Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; a law-stele cult over a solar and tomb-cult overlay.
religion.the_one: Atharnu (< Punic Atharon < Aeternus; the great distant maker, honored through His ministers)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Atharnu the distant maker, Tulrishu the just-judge of the law-stele, Urlanzu of the sworn iron, Rialtu the merciful mother - inscribed on the stele and honored in the sun-temple; the Chaotic powers are named -lemnu (evil) and warded.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the justified dead and the ancestral law-givers (the deified Just) and the city-spirits of the Bit-ili / Per-netjer; the great powers invoked at temple and tomb-chapel situationally.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (the Coin-Serpent, the City-Burner, the Devourer), and names the Lawful powers - and Atharnu - as the distant tyrant-makers to be defied; the law-stele is a thing to be broken.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: each opposing power (the Chaotic 13 for this Lawful-leaning realm) keeps its morphed name + its own portfolio epithet (distinct per power; '-lemnu' = evil may be appended): Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner; Lusanto -> Lusantu the Coin-Serpent; Vacidus -> Wakidu the Devourer.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili / Per-netjer (god-house/temple) of [power]: 'the Bit-ili of Tulrishu'.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and the justified dead, on the temple-stele and in tomb-chapels; 'the Just [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Rialtu: a sheltering disc-and-crescent above the mother-throne

banks_patterns.ships: river-barge and Red-Sea trader names: 'Pride of the Naru', 'Barque of Tulrishu', 'Bringer of Qutrinnu'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [god] Standard / the [number] Companies: 'the Standard of Urlanzu'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried ziggurats and tomb-cities: 'the Ziggurat of Dur-[name]', 'the Sunken Per-[name]'
